import_provenance.original_title: The sharp selfishness threshold for manipulation-resistant tournaments
import_provenance.original_statement: Does every number of teams admit a monotone, Condorcet-consistent randomized tournament rule satisfying 2-NM₁? Under this condition a pair cannot gain more total winning probability by fixing its match than the probability sacrificed by the team that loses deliberately.
import_provenance.supplied_caveat: Remark: The December 2025 construction already achieves the constant threshold 11; the open conjecture is the optimal threshold 1, not merely the existence of any constant.
